note: Test inventory classification. Every file under tests/**/*.js is classified exactly once as 'strict' (real test module/helper, held to the strict tests lint/typecheck boundary), 'harness-fragment' (temporary non-spec harness naming an existing parent, reason, and removal path), or 'fixture' (executable negative fixture intentionally invalid, naming an existing owner test and reason). Numeric split-spec fragments are retired; split any future oversized family by behavior into strict Base.<topic>.test.js files and extract common setup once into a strict helper or an existing captured harness. Enforced by tools/quality-policy/test-inventory.mjs.
